ai.modalDesc:
AI will analyze the current worldview and existing careers to intelligently generate complementary new careers.
You can generate multiple times to gradually complete the career system without replacing existing careers.
ai.userRequirementsExtra: Optional. Describe desired new career directions, ability focus, constraints, or career types to avoid; AI will combine the worldview and existing careers.
